policy: Catalog presence is not a binary or execution claim. Native command aliases are backed by compiled source; external providers require verified binaries. ISA rows with zero forms are catalog-only and nonzero rows are partial until instruction semantics pass architecture-specific conformance tests.

binary_build_matrix.binary_status: generated only by successful target-specific CI; no binary status is predeclared
binary_build_matrix.runtime_status: requires native or QEMU-user execution; cross-compiled ELF headers alone do not prove runtime semantics
